verses.text: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
lines: We give thanks to you, God.
We give thanks, for your Name is near.
Men tell about your wondrous works.

verses.text: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
lines: When I choose the appointed time,
I will judge blamelessly.

verses.text: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars.
lines: The earth and all its inhabitants quake.
I firmly hold its pillars.

verses.text: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
lines: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!”
I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

verses.text: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
lines: Don’t lift up your horn on high.
Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

verses.text: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
lines: For neither from the east, nor from the west,
nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

verses.text: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
lines: But God is the judge.
He puts down one, and lifts up another.

verses.text: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
lines: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup,
full of foaming wine mixed with spices.
He pours it out.
Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

verses.text: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
lines: But I will declare this forever:
I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.text: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
lines: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked,
but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
